changelog: New TV screens in the Cucù style (warm grey, pastel hand-made shapes, grain, website illustrations): 'Put a figurine' while waiting, a new 'The end / take the figurine off' screen when an episode ends, 'Another one? Let's decide together' after it is removed, and a sleeping owl when time limits block viewing (previously all showed the waiting screen). New hourglass overlay and boot splash on the new background; the old TinyWorlds splash is gone. A figurine blocked by time limits after an episode is no longer retried ten times a second. Web app: the device render is centred on the Now page.
